newsitem.title: USA: Northport sets higher Great Eastern bid.
newsitem.headline: Northport sets higher Great Eastern bid.

text.p: Northport Operating Co LC said Friday it is offering $0.23 per share for Great Eastern Energy and Development Corp, pointing out this is a greater value than the $0.22 offered by Caprito Gas Corp.
Great Eastern's stock last traded on June 27, when it closed at $0.25 a share.
Northport said its offer for all of 18,844,245 Great Eastern shares is conditioned on 80 percent being tendered.
The Northport Production Co unit also said it is offering Great Eastern holders a financial inducement to retain some of their shares to maintain the public status of the company.

Calling this inducement "a second option," Northport said it will accept up to 75 percent of Great Eastern's outstanding shares from shareholders electing the second option, paying $0.26 per share for half the shares tendered.
The remaining half, at Northport's option, would either be purchased at $0.23 per share or returned to the shareholder.
To the extent that more than 75 percent of Great Eastern shares are tendered pursuant to the second option, the excess shares will be purchased at $0.23 per share.

Upon successful completion of this offer, Northport said, it will be merged into Great Eastern, which will continue to operate as a public corporation under the surviving name of Great Eastern Energy and Development Corp.
It said funds needed to complete this offer will be provided by bank financing in the amount of $3.2 million, with additional capital provided from other sources.
